## 작업 상태와 재개 {#recovery}

**시작 수락 미확정:** `detached_job_acceptance_pending` 영수증은 durable job 행의 수락이 확인되지 않은 상태이며 worker가 이미 있을 수 있습니다. 고정 main `592c667f`는 알려진 pending 영수증을 조회할 때 `acceptance_pending` 비종결로 표시할 수 있지만, release `0.59.9`의 `ouroboros_job_result`는 행을 찾지 못하면 `job_handle_not_found`, `lifecycle_status: invalid`, `is_terminal: true`를 반환할 수 있습니다. 이는 작업 종료의 증거가 아닙니다. 후속 not found만으로 중복 실행하지 말고 원래 영수증과 실제 ID, 같은 서버·DB, 소유자 및 진행 중인 작업을 확인하세요. `job_wait`의 not-found 표시는 별도 계약입니다. 실제 호스트 schema·worker 상태는 미검증입니다. [main pending 조회](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/job_read_state.py#L124-L160) · [release result](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/job_handlers.py#L2065-L2083) · [시작 영수증](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/background.py#L295-L310)

**Interview 입력 판본 차이:** 고정 main `592c667f`의 `ouroboros_interview`는 비어 있지 않은 `calibration_input`을 `answer`·재개보다 먼저 처리합니다. release `0.59.9`의 schema와 handler에는 `calibration_input`과 `interview_calibration`이 없으며, 지원하지 않는 인자가 handler까지 전달된 경우 `initial_context` 없이 `session_id`와 해당 calibration 인자만 있으면 재개 분기, `answer`도 있으면 답변 분기로 갈 수 있습니다. 호스트나 schema가 먼저 인자를 거부할 수도 있습니다. release에는 두 인자를 보내지 말고 기존 호스트 대화에서 설명을 요청하세요. 세션 ID와 진행 상태를 보존하고 추가 모델 호출·비용 가능성을 확인하세요. 설치된 서버의 실제 schema와 호스트 동작은 미검증입니다. [main 분기](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2100-L2125) · [main 입력](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/interview_calibration.py#L22-L42) · [release 분기](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2093-L2115)

원래 실행에 연결된 평가·Ralph 작업은 별도로 계속될 수 있습니다. 중지가 끝났는지 판단하기 전에 [후속 작업의 ID와 종료 상태](#chained-job-checks)를 확인하세요.

연결이 끊겼다고 기존 작업이 중단됐다고 단정하지 마세요. 원래 호스트 대화의 시작 도구와 실제 반환 필드명을 먼저 확인하고, `job_id`, `session_id`, `execution_id`, `auto_session_id`를 구분하세요. `session_id`라는 필드명만으로 실행 세션이라고 단정할 수 없습니다. Interview MCP 시작 응답의 `session_id`는 `state.interview_id`이며, 오케스트레이터 실행 세션과 다른 ID입니다. 아래 실행 세션 명령에 넣지 마세요. CLI `ouroboros status run --session-id`는 오케스트레이터 세션 ID만 받습니다. MCP 도구 `ouroboros_session_status`는 오케스트레이터 세션을 조회하고 `auto_<id>`도 받아 auto 세션 상태를 반환합니다. Interview ID는 별도 유형입니다. [main Interview 시작 응답](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2661-L2713) · [main 상태 조회 범위](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/query_handlers.py#L291-L323) · [main 세션 재구성 조건](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/session.py#L1298-L1342) · [CLI run 상태 옵션](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py#L374-L389). 같은 범위는 release `v0.59.9`에서도 대조했습니다([Interview 응답](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2686-L2738), [상태 조회](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/query_handlers.py#L291-L323), [재구성 조건](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/session.py#L1298-L1342), [CLI 옵션](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py#L374-L389)).

```bash
ouroboros job status JOB_ID
ouroboros job result JOB_ID
ouroboros status execution EXECUTION_ID --events
ouroboros status run --session-id ORCHESTRATOR_SESSION_ID
ouroboros status auto AUTO_SESSION_ID
ouroboros resume --list
ouroboros resume --all --list
```

Interview를 이어가려면 원래 호스트/MCP에서 같은 `session_id`를 `ouroboros_interview`에 전달하고 사용자가 실제로 답한 내용을 `answer`로 보냅니다. 이 호출은 상태만 읽는 조회가 아니며 다음 질문 생성 등으로 모델 호출과 비용이 생길 수 있습니다. 독립 CLI의 인터뷰라면 **원래와 같은 상태 디렉터리**에서 `ouroboros init list`로 ID를 찾고 `ouroboros init start --resume INTERVIEW_ID`로 이어갑니다. `--state-dir`를 사용했다면 두 명령 모두 같은 경로를 지정하세요. `ouroboros resume --list`는 실행 세션 목록이지 인터뷰 목록이 아닙니다. 호스트 위임 응답이 `delegated_to_subagent`라면 receipt의 ID를 쓰지 말고 원래 호스트의 Task pane에서 실제 반환된 ID를 확인하세요. [main Interview continuation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2280-L2305) · [main CLI 인터뷰 resume/list](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L1028-L1034) · [목록과 state-dir](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L1212-L1246). 동일 동작은 release `v0.59.9`의 [Interview continuation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2263-L2324) 및 [CLI 목록/resume](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L1028-L1034)에서도 확인했습니다.

`ouroboros init start --resume INTERVIEW_ID`도 상태 조회만 하는 명령은 아닙니다. 인터뷰를 이어가며 질문·평가에 모델을 호출하고 비용이 생기거나 저장된 인터뷰 상태를 갱신할 수 있습니다. 진행에 따라 `Proceed to generate Seed specification?` 질문의 기본값은 `yes`이고, Seed를 만들면 뒤이어 `Start workflow now?`도 기본값 `yes`로 실제 workflow 실행을 시작할 수 있습니다. Seed를 검토한 뒤 실행하려면 `Start workflow now?`에서 기본값을 받아들이지 말고 `n`을 입력하세요. Seed 생성도 원하지 않으면 앞의 Seed 확인 질문에서 `n`을 선택합니다. [main 인터뷰/Seed/실행 흐름](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L560-L654) · [main Seed 저장과 실행 handoff](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L748-L812) · [release 흐름](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L559-L653) · [release Seed 저장과 실행 handoff](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L748-L812).

`job result`는 같은 실제 ID의 종료 출력이며, 성공한 작업뿐 아니라 `failed`, `cancelled`, `interrupted` 결과도 읽습니다. 상태·오류 필드와 반환된 실패 텍스트/페이로드를 작업 결과의 증거로 확인하세요. 조회 성공은 기록을 읽었다는 뜻이지 작업이 완료 조건을 통과했다는 뜻은 아닙니다. 기준 main 소스의 `worker_blocked`는 워커 판정 클래스에서 파생된 제한된 실패 범주이며, 그 자체로 실제 원인을 특정하지 않습니다. 결과와 연결된 세션·실행 ID, 워커의 관련 출력을 확인한 뒤에만 원인을 판단하세요. 소유 호스트에서 확인할 수 있다면 관련 stdout/stderr, 권한 오류, 선택된 backend/runtime 및 환경 오류를 필요한 범위에서 살펴보고, 공유 전 토큰·키·자격 증명과 무관한 환경값을 가리세요. job result가 원시 stdout/stderr를 항상 보존한다고 소스가 보장하지는 않습니다. 기존 작업 폴더·브랜치·미커밋 파일과 외부 효과를 보존하고, 소유자나 현재 상태가 불확실한 동안 재실행·재개·취소·중복 시작을 하지 마세요. `resume --list`는 실행 세션 후보 목록이며 인터뷰 목록이나 실제 재개가 아닙니다. 목록은 제한되거나 기록 재구성에 실패한 항목을 놓칠 수 있으므로 빈 결과를 작업 부재의 증거로 삼지 마세요. DB 열기 오류는 이력 없음과 다릅니다. [job 결과·상태 의미](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/job_handlers.py), [워커 실패 범주](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/run_failure_cause.py), [상태 조회 구현](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py), [재개 목록 구현](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/resume.py). 기준 소스는 `592c667` main이며 설치 릴리스와 호스트 연동은 다를 수 있습니다.

더 많은 실행 세션 후보를 보려면 `ouroboros resume --all --list`를 사용합니다. 정상적인 snapshot 경로에서는 기본 최근 20개 제한을 해제하지만, 재구성할 수 있는 `running` 또는 `paused` 세션 후보만 표시하고 재구성에 실패한 기록은 제외합니다. 오래된 EventStore의 fallback은 세션 이벤트를 다시 훑으면서 이 제한을 적용하지 않을 수 있으므로 `--all`을 추가해도 결과가 늘지 않을 수 있습니다. 어느 목록도 워커 프로세스가 현재 살아 있음, 전체 과거 이력, 작업 재개를 보장하지 않습니다. 설치된 도움말을 확인하고 이미 알고 있는 작업은 원래 ID로 따로 조회하세요. 이 동작은 기준 main과 release `v0.59.9`에서 확인했습니다: [main resume 구현](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/resume.py) · [release `v0.59.9`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/resume.py).

재개·취소·새 실행 전에는 기존 소유자와 최종 상태, Seed **파일 경로**, 작업 폴더·브랜치, 미커밋 파일 및 이미 발생한 외부 효과를 확인합니다. 응답이 사라진 것만으로 새 실행을 만들지 마세요. 이 기준 소스에서 `run workflow --resume`은 프로세스에만 있던 check package를 복구하지 못하는 특정 경우 이전 세션을 실패로 기록한 뒤 새 시도를 시작할 수 있습니다. 현재 설치의 동작과 대상 경로를 확인하고 선택하세요. 취소가 이미 발생한 외부 효과를 되돌리는 것도 아닙니다. [실행 재개 구현](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/run.py), [복구 안내](/docs/recovery-detail/).


### 별도로 이어진 후속 작업 확인 {#chained-job-checks}

원래 job이나 실행의 취소가 별도로 등록된 평가·Ralph job의 중단을 보장하지는 않습니다. 중지가 끝났다고 판단하기 전에 다음 순서로 확인하세요.

1. 원래 실행의 최종 결과에 `chained_evaluate_job_id`가 있으면 같은 서버에서 그 평가 job의 상태를 조회하고, 종결 상태일 때 결과를 읽습니다.
2. 평가 결과에 `chained_ralph_job_id`가 있으면 그 Ralph job도 같은 방법으로 확인합니다. 두 ID는 해당 후속 등록이 성공했을 때만 나타나므로, 모든 실행에 있다고 가정하거나 없는 ID를 추측하지 마세요.
3. 사용자가 실행 중인 후속 작업도 멈추라고 명시적으로 요청했다면 정확한 ID와 소유자를 확인하고, 설치된 서버의 `ouroboros_cancel_job` 입력 schema에 맞춰 해당 job마다 취소를 요청합니다.
4. 각 job의 상태와 종결 결과를 다시 조회하고 이미 발생한 파일 변경·외부 효과를 확인합니다. 취소 요청은 종료 완료나 변경 복구를 보장하지 않습니다. 상태나 소유자가 불확실하면 기존 기록과 작업 공간을 보존하고 대체 실행을 시작하지 마세요.

고정 main과 release `v0.59.9`의 근거: [main 평가 연결](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/run_evaluate_chain.py#L150-L175) · [main Ralph 연결](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/evaluate_ralph_chain.py#L462-L472) · [main job 취소](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/job_handlers.py#L2148-L2189) · [release 평가 연결](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/run_evaluate_chain.py#L150-L175) · [release Ralph 연결](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/evaluate_ralph_chain.py#L462-L472). 실제 설치 판본·호스트 연동은 다를 수 있습니다.

## 업데이트가 부분 실패했을 때 {#update}

**갱신 대상부터 구분하세요.** plugin-only 설치는 전역 `ouroboros` 명령이 없어도 정상일 수 있고, `ooo update` 스킬은 별도 CLI를 전제로 합니다. CLI 부재·도움말 오류만으로 구형 설치라고 단정하거나 새 전역 설치를 자동 처방하지 마세요. CLI 패키지·호스트 plugin·실제 MCP 서버를 따로 식별하고, 고정 Codex descriptor의 `==0.59.9` pin과 plugin 참조를 확인합니다. 패키지가 최신이면 updater는 runtime refresh 전에 반환하므로 반복 실행·`--runtime all`로 plugin/server 복구를 강제할 수 없습니다. [설치 형태별 갱신 경계](/docs/update-detail/#plugin-only-update)를 먼저 확인하세요.

`ouroboros update --check`는 원격 배포 정보를 조회하므로 오프라인 검사가 아닙니다. 갱신 전 설치 관리자, 실제 실행 파일, 선택된 호스트와 진행 중인 작업을 확인하세요. 설정·플러그인 refresh는 파일을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

`Ouroboros partially updated`가 나오면 패키지는 이미 바뀌었을 수 있습니다. 같은 환경의 `ouroboros --version`과 출력된 실패 단계·복구 안내를 확인하고, 필요한 조치의 대상을 살핀 뒤 수행하세요. 이 소스에서는 이미 최신 상태에서 `ouroboros update`를 다시 실행해도 실패한 런타임 refresh를 자동 재시도하지 않습니다. 기존 설정을 삭제하거나 덮어써 오류를 숨기지 마세요. [업데이트 구현](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/update.py), [상세 안내](/docs/update-detail/).

## 결과 확인과 인계 {#verify}

조치 후에는 같은 기기·호스트·설치에서 원래 증상을 다시 확인합니다. 실행 결과는 Seed 목표와 완료 조건, 실제 변경 파일, 테스트·평가의 출력 및 남은 실패와 대조합니다. job ID, health의 `ok`, 조회 성공, 실행 완료 표시 또는 평가 요청 자체는 요구 충족의 증거가 아닙니다. 모델 호출이나 실제 클라이언트 연결을 별도 시험하지 않았다면 그렇게 밝힙니다.

AI는 가린 오류와 판본, 확인한 ID 종류, 실제 수행한 검사와 결과, 변경 사항, 남은 불확실성 및 복구에 필요한 정보를 사용자에게 전달하세요. 상태나 외부 효과를 특정할 수 없다면 기록을 보존하고 임의로 재실행하지 않습니다. 더 자세한 흐름은 [진행상태](/docs/progress-detail/), [실패 복구](/docs/recovery-detail/), [진단 명령](/docs/diagnostics-detail/)을 참고하세요. 이 연결 페이지는 별도 판본 범위를 표시하므로 해당 표시를 함께 확인하세요.

content/en/ai-troubleshooting.md.prior: # Troubleshoot Ouroboros with an AI assistant Use this guide when installation, an MCP connection, an execution, or an update does not behave as expected. Identify the affected environment, inspect the symptom, preserve existing work, choose a targeted action, and verify the outcome. A host plugin can work without a standalone `ouroboros` command in your shell. **Version boundary:** This guide describes source revision [`592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/tree/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0), checked on 2026-11-07. A published package, a host plugin, and the MCP server launched by that host can be different versions. Check the help and behavior of the installation involved before applying these instructions. Source review and package inclusion do not establish that every host, authentication method, model, or recovery path has been tested. ## Start here Tell the assistant which machine and operating system, host application, project directory, command or request, symptom, and last error are involved. Preserve the actual job, session, execution, and auto-session IDs, if any. Ask the assistant to distinguish observations from inferences, and commands it actually ran from commands it recommends. If the affected environment has a standalone CLI, run these in its shell: ```bash command -v ouroboros ouroboros --version ouroboros --help ``` In PowerShell, use `Get-Command ouroboros` to locate the command. The result identifies that shell's CLI, not necessarily the MCP server launched by a host. If the command is missing, check the host's own plugin and MCP status; do not install another CLI solely to infer the host server's version. A different machine, user, home directory, virtual environment, or host session can select a different installation. For a source checkout, `git rev-parse HEAD` identifies that checkout, not a separately installed package. **Review output before sharing it.** Paths, project names, prompts, IDs, configuration errors, and launcher arguments can contain private information or secrets. Redact them as appropriate. Do not send credentials, tokens, a complete environment dump, or an entire configuration file. In particular, `doctor install` can display configured launcher arguments. ## Choose the symptom | Symptom | First step | If that does not resolve it | | --- | --- | --- | | The shell cannot find `ouroboros`, or the host does not recognize `ooo` | Separate the standalone CLI from the host plugin; check the affected session and installed version. | Inspect the host's plugin status and installation instructions for that version. Do not assume one installation proves the other. | | MCP tools are unavailable or connection fails | Check whether the host reports its server enabled and connected; preserve the redacted error. | Follow [MCP connection](#mcp-connection-or-authentication-fails). | | Authentication fails or health reports a credential warning | Identify the selected backend and the environment that actually launches it. Check its supported login or credential setup without sharing the credential. | A credential-presence check does not prove validity; follow [MCP connection](#mcp-connection-or-authentication-fails) and verify an authorized connection separately. | | A job appears stuck or a client disconnected | Preserve the original IDs, workspace and owner; query the existing work. | Follow [Status and recovery](#recovery) before retrying. | | Codex uses broader file or network access than expected | Check the existing job, actual worker command, and product/Codex versions. | Follow [Permission and isolation scope](#permission-scope). | | An update reports partial failure | Identify which package and refresh step changed. | Follow [Update and partial failure](#update-and-partial-failure). | | A job completed but the result seems wrong | Compare the Seed and actual files, tests and evaluation evidence. | Follow [Verify and report](#verify-and-report). | ## Diagnose without assuming a pass proves success Run the following in the affected CLI environment only if that installation provides them. Consult the relevant `--help` first and inspect the individual errors and warnings, not just the exit code. These checks are diagnostic, not repair commands; nevertheless, logging, initialization, and dependency imports can create local traces or make network requests. They are not a promise of offline or OS-isolated operation. | Command | What it inspects | What a pass does not establish | | --- | --- | --- | | `ouroboros doctor install` | Package, plugin and MCP installation surfaces and launcher information. | A live host connection or successful task. | | `ouroboros status health` | Configuration, database path, runtime availability and credential presence. | Valid authentication, a model call, or successful execution. | | `ouroboros mcp doctor` | MCP prerequisites; the default does not start a server. | The actual host connection or a model call. | | `ouroboros mcp doctor-runtime` | Bounded executable provenance, ephemeral loopback bindability and Ouroboros server registry metadata. | A live connection between the host and server. | | `ouroboros codex doctor` | Codex `ooo auto` dispatch artifacts and MCP configuration. | A live host connection or model call. | `doctor install`, `mcp doctor`, and `mcp doctor-runtime` support `--json` in the source revision above. For `mcp doctor`, `--machine-snapshot --json` returns an object containing `checks` and `machine_snapshot` rather than the default list. Redact either form before sharing. A configuration error in `status health` remains important even if other rows report `ok`. See the [installation doctor](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/doctor.py), [MCP doctor](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/mcp_doctor.py), and [health implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py). ## MCP connection or authentication fails 1. In the original host session, check whether the plugin and Ouroboros server are enabled and whether the error concerns server startup, connection, tool discovery, or authentication. Inspect the server's command or URL and environment without exposing secrets. A CLI health pass does not prove that this host uses that CLI or server. For Codex CLI, `codex mcp list` shows configured servers; in the Codex CLI TUI, `/mcp` shows MCP servers active in that session. A listed or active server does not by itself prove that a particular tool call succeeds. Do not infer that a plugin-bundled server is missing only because it is absent from `codex mcp list`; check the plugin and current session in the relevant host. See [OpenAI's Codex MCP setup guidance](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp?surface=cli#configure-with-the-cli). Codex plugin skill discovery and its bundled MCP server are separate: seeing `ouroboros-help` does not establish that the server or its tools are available, and an MCP server listing does not establish that the help skill was discovered. The plugin descriptor lists skills and MCP configuration separately ([manifest](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/.codex-plugin/plugin.json), [bundled server configuration](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/.mcp.codex.json)); verify the relevant capability in the current host session. In the cited main and release welcome flows, `CODEX_SETUP_REQUIRED` is a readiness result, not a live check of the plugin's bundled MCP server: the gate also requires Codex runtime and LLM backends, a runnable Codex CLI, and an `mcp_servers.ouroboros` entry in `$CODEX_HOME/config.toml`. Because the marketplace plugin declares its MCP server separately, an active plugin server can coexist with this result. Do not repeat `ouroboros setup --runtime codex` solely because of this message; first inspect the current host session and the target configuration. Codex setup can write persistent MCP registration and runtime/model settings. See [main welcome readiness gate](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/skills/welcome/SKILL.md#L545-L592), [release welcome readiness gate](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/skills/welcome/SKILL.md#L545-L592), and [Codex setup implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/setup.py#L2752-L2900). 2. If the relevant standalone CLI is available, read the failing rows of `ouroboros mcp doctor`. For Codex, `ouroboros codex doctor` checks the `ooo auto` dispatch setup. A failure gives a starting point; inspect the suggested changes and target before applying them. A pass still does not prove the host connection. **What Codex doctor checks:** In fixed main `592c667f` and release `0.59.9`, `ouroboros codex doctor` uses explicit `--codex-dir` first, otherwise `$CODEX_HOME`, otherwise `~/.codex`. It requires `rules/ouroboros.md`, `skills/ouroboros-auto/SKILL.md`, and an `mcp_servers.ouroboros` entry in that root's `config.toml`. It does not substitute discovery of a marketplace plugin's separate cache and bundled descriptor for those managed assets. A `BROKEN` result due to missing managed assets does not establish that an active plugin is broken. Do not automatically run the printed `codex refresh` suggestion; first identify the installation path and tools in the current host session, and review existing settings and the intended changes before installing or refreshing separate managed assets. [main checks](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/codex.py#L186-L285) · [release checks](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/codex.py#L186-L285) 3. If an additional process is appropriate, `ouroboros mcp doctor --probe-local-stdio` starts a temporary local child and checks startup and tool discovery without invoking a tool. It does not test the host's configured launcher, authentication, or model. Its Python-level restrictions are not OS confinement; interpreter startup can precede them. Ordinary doctor checks may also attempt network access. 4. `ouroboros codex doctor --live-mcp` instead launches the **configured stdio server** and checks discovery. Inspect that launcher and its potential network and other effects first. This option does not verify a URL transport or a model call. See the [Codex doctor implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/codex.py). 5. If setup reports `No runtimes found.`, inspect the runtime executable, configuration and help in the setup process's environment. Detection can involve more than the current shell's PATH. Setup and refresh can change configuration and artifacts; a failed setup does not prove that no local state was created. Preserve existing files and inspect the failed step before retrying. See [setup](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/setup.py). 6. In the Python `MCPClientAdapter` path, an SDK exception whose text contains `not found` can be misclassified as a missing tool. One comparison using the candidate offline dev server and an independent MCP SDK call checked a registered `ouroboros_job_result` with a synthetic nonexistent job ID: `Job handle not found` surfaced from the adapter as `Tool not found: ouroboros_job_result`. This is one observed Python-adapter path, not a rule for every host or SDK. Before classifying this message, confirm the same host is connected to the intended server, inspect that server's actual registered tool list, and compare the exact job ID with the original start response. Preserve the original structured error and relevant versions, but do not share secrets, full environment/configuration, or sensitive payloads. See the `MCPClientAdapter` exception handling in [main](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/client/adapter.py#L408-L412) and [release `v0.59.9`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/client/adapter.py#L408-L412). **Native Windows Codex Desktop exception:** In both the cited main source and release `v0.59.9`, setup's `auto` mode can preserve an existing MCP entry, or skip a new persistent entry, while returning success. Inspect the actual Ouroboros entry and the host's current tool list; setup's success alone proves neither registration nor connection. Review only the relevant config entry and redact paths or arguments before sharing. For the separate loopback HTTP mode, first check the installed `ouroboros setup --help` and the exact target. Only within the user's approved configuration change, run `ouroboros setup --runtime codex --mcp-mode http`; it prints a server command that must be started separately before opening Codex and registers `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp`. If using stdio on Windows, use the Codex CLI in WSL 2 and check that WSL environment. See [Windows behavior at main](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/windows_codex_mcp.py) and [release `v0.59.9`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/windows_codex_mcp.py). After an authorized correction, repeat the relevant check in the same host and environment. If a real connection or model call was not tested, report that limit. ## Codex permission and isolation scope differs from expectations {#permission-scope} 1. Start in the original host conversation: identify the `job_id`, `session_id`, `execution_id`, owner, and current state. Follow [Status and recovery](#recovery) to query that same job and its result. Do not start a duplicate or terminate a user-owned session just because a response disappeared. 2. Inspect the actual worker command and selected backend/runtime for that job. Codex `--sandbox workspace-write` allows writes in the workspace while retaining a sandbox; `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` bypasses both Codex approvals and its sandbox. Do not infer effective permissions from a setting name alone, and do not dump tokens or complete environment/config files. 3. Permission can vary by path. When no permission mode is supplied to `CodexCliRuntime` itself, its default is `acceptEdits`, mapped to `workspace-write`. That default does not describe every internal call. With no explicit permission, the `use_case="interview"` Codex factory may select bypass for question generation. The `OrchestratorRunner` can overwrite the adapter permission mode passed to it with `bypassPermissions`; eligible cross-harness retries and a specific pytest collection-error repair path also set bypass separately. Do not assume a single Codex setting constrains nested runs and retries. These paths were checked in product main `592c667` and release **0.59.9**. 4. Check the host OS isolation actually applied: process namespaces, visible files and writable paths, and network egress. If a Codex sandbox-bypass flag appears, do not treat Codex configuration alone as proof of OS isolation. 5. If the job owner or live process is unknown, preserve its files, branch and external effects; do not terminate a user session or change authentication/configuration. Before stopping or cancelling, identify the exact job and owner process and check effects already made. 6. `model_tier=small` requests a starting tier; it does not guarantee that tier or cap cost, tokens, or model request count. Whether it takes effect and which model runs can depend on an explicit model pin, router activation conditions, and the runtime’s native model-override support. Separate role calls may also occur. Retries or tier escalation may create additional sessions or use a higher tier. Check available per-job/session model, token, and cost records. If usage evidence is unavailable, report it as unknown and do not repeat the run just to measure it. Sources: for main `592c667`, see the [Codex factory](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/providers/factory.py#L113-L143), [runtime default](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/codex_cli_runtime.py#L479-L492), [Codex flag mapping](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/codex_permissions.py#L26-L50), [task runner forced mode](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/runner.py#L731-L732) and [adapter-mode override in `OrchestratorRunner`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/runner.py#L5190-L5217), [cross-harness retry](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/parallel_executor.py#L7068-L7074), [pytest collection repair](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/server/adapter.py#L2147-L2159), and [model-tier mapping](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/model_routing.py#L124-L180), [router activation conditions](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/model_routing.py#L381-L428), and [whether the selected tier is enforced](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/model_routing.py#L503-L541). The corresponding release `v0.59.9` paths are [factory](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/providers/factory.py#L113-L143), [runtime default](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/codex_cli_runtime.py#L479-L492), [flag mapping](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/codex_permissions.py#L26-L50), [runner forced mode](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/runner.py#L731-L732) and [adapter-mode override](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/runner.py#L5190-L5217), [cross-harness](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/parallel_executor.py#L7052-L7057), [validation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/server/adapter.py#L2147-L2159), and [tier routing](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/model_routing.py#L124-L180), [router activation conditions](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/model_routing.py#L381-L428), and [whether the selected tier is enforced](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/model_routing.py#L503-L541). ## Status and recovery after a disconnect A closed client or missing response does not establish that a worker stopped. Find the original host conversation, start tool, and returned field names first; distinguish `job_id`, `session_id`, `execution_id`, and `auto_session_id`. A field named `session_id` does not by itself mean an execution session. An Interview MCP start response uses `state.interview_id` as its `session_id`; that is a different ID from an orchestrator execution session. Do not pass it to the execution-session commands below. `ouroboros status run --session-id` accepts orchestrator session IDs only. The MCP tool `ouroboros_session_status` queries orchestrator sessions and also handles `auto_` IDs by returning auto-session status; an Interview ID is a separate type. See [main Interview start response](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2661-L2713), [main status query scope](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/query_handlers.py#L291-L323), [main session reconstruction requirement](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/session.py#L1298-L1342), and [CLI run status option](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py#L374-L389). The same behavior was checked in release `v0.59.9`: [Interview response](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2686-L2738), [status query](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/query_handlers.py#L291-L323), [reconstruction requirement](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/session.py#L1298-L1342), and [CLI option](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py#L374-L389). For standalone CLI status checks, replace each placeholder below with the **matching ID of the indicated type**, and check the installed help first: An original run may have separately chained evaluation or Ralph jobs. If its result includes `chained_evaluate_job_id`, query that exact job on the same server and read its terminal result; if that result includes `chained_ralph_job_id`, do the same for Ralph. These IDs appear only when the corresponding enqueue succeeds. Stopping the original job does not prove a chained job stopped. Do not invent missing IDs or cancel a follow-up automatically. If a result or owner is uncertain, preserve the records and workspace; see [the detailed chained-job checks](#chained-job-checks). Choose only the row matching the ID or list you need; do not run every command. For a job, query its status first and read its result when it is terminal. | What you have | Standalone CLI command | Next step | | --- | --- | --- | | Job ID | `ouroboros job status JOB_ID` | When terminal, use `ouroboros job result JOB_ID` for that same job. | | Execution ID | `ouroboros status execution EXECUTION_ID --events` | Inspect the returned events and linked IDs. | | Orchestrator session ID | `ouroboros status run --session-id ORCHESTRATOR_SESSION_ID` | Inspect the returned session status. | | Auto session ID | `ouroboros status auto AUTO_SESSION_ID` | Inspect auto-session status and linked work. | | Execution-session ID is missing | `ouroboros resume --list` | For a wider candidate list, use `ouroboros resume --all --list`; neither command resumes work. | ### Resume an interview To continue an Interview, use the same `session_id` with `ouroboros_interview` in the original host/MCP and send the user's actual answer as `answer`. This is a continuation, not a status-only query; it can generate another question and incur model calls and cost. For a standalone CLI interview, use the **same state directory as before** with `ouroboros init list` to find its ID, then `ouroboros init start --resume INTERVIEW_ID` to continue it. If you used `--state-dir`, pass that same path to both commands. `ouroboros resume --list` lists execution sessions, not interviews. If the host returned `delegated_to_subagent`, use the actual ID shown in the original host's Task pane; the delegation receipt is not the interview ID. See [main Interview continuation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2280-L2305), [main CLI interview resume option](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L1028-L1034), and [CLI list/state directory](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L1212-L1246). The same behavior was checked in release `v0.59.9`: [Interview continuation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2263-L2324) and [CLI resume/list](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L1028-L1034). **Interview calibration depends on the server version.** The fixed main source `592c667f` recognizes a non-empty `calibration_input` as a calibration action before ordinary start, answer, or resume dispatch. Release `v0.59.9` does not expose that field in its Interview schema or handle it as calibration: if an unsupported argument nevertheless reaches the handler without `initial_context`, it selects an answer when `answer` is present and otherwise a resume, which requires `session_id`; a host or schema may reject the argument earlier. Do not send `calibration_input` or `interview_calibration` to that release or assume it was processed; an answer or resume can change interview state and invoke a model. Check the actual connected server's tool schema and version, preserve the pending question, and use only the input that server supports; ask for an explanation in the existing host conversation instead. See [main action selection](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2100-L2128), [main calibration parameters](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/interview_calibration.py#L22-L42), and [release action selection](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2093-L2123). Other installed versions or host schemas require separate checking. `ouroboros init start --resume INTERVIEW_ID` is not a read-only status command. It continues the interview, can call the selected model for questions or scoring (and incur cost), and can update saved interview state. Depending on the path, `Proceed to generate Seed specification?` defaults to `yes`; generating a Seed writes an artifact. After Seed generation, `Start workflow now?` also defaults to `yes`, so accepting the default (pressing Enter) can start actual workflow execution. To inspect the Seed before execution, enter `n` at `Start workflow now?`; if you do not want a Seed generated, enter `n` at the Seed prompt. See [main interview, Seed, and workflow flow](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L560-L654), [main Seed persistence and workflow handoff](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L748-L812), [release flow](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L559-L653), and [release Seed persistence and workflow handoff](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L748-L812). ### Inspect jobs and execution sessions `job result` reads the terminal output for the same job ID, including a `failed`, `cancelled`, or `interrupted` job; it is not limited to successful work. Read its status/error fields and returned failure text or payload as evidence about the outcome. A successful query only means the record was read; it does not mean the work passed its criteria. In the cited main source, `worker_blocked` is a closed failure category derived from a worker judgement class. It does not identify the underlying reason by itself. Inspect the actual result, any linked session or execution ID, and the worker's relevant output before attributing the cause. If available through the owning host, inspect only the relevant stdout/stderr and permission, backend/runtime, and environment error details; redact tokens, keys, credentials, and unrelated environment values before sharing. The source does not guarantee that raw stdout/stderr is persisted in the job result. Preserve the existing workspace, branch, uncommitted files, and external effects; do not rerun, resume, cancel, or start a duplicate while the owner or current state is uncertain. `resume --list` lists execution-session candidates; it is not an Interview list and does not resume them. A list can be limited or omit sessions whose records could not be reconstructed, so an empty list is not proof that no work exists. A database open error is not an empty history. See [job result and status semantics](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/job_handlers.py), [worker failure categories](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/run_failure_cause.py), [status](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py), and [resume listing](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/resume.py). The cited source is main at `592c667`; installed releases and host integrations may differ. **A pending detached start is not proof of a failed or completed job.** If the original start returned `detached_job_acceptance_pending`, preserve that receipt and its exact `job_id`. In main `592c667f`, when the normal snapshot lookup cannot find a job but a matching pending receipt is known, `ouroboros_job_result` can return non-terminal `acceptance_pending` with worker state unknown. In release `v0.59.9`, the same missing durable lookup can instead return `job_handle_not_found` with `lifecycle_status: invalid` and `is_terminal: true`; those fields describe the lookup response and do not prove the worker stopped or that it is safe to restart. Check the original receipt and ID, the connected server and its version, and the owning process or host; inspect the same job through the supported status path. If acceptance or ownership remains uncertain, preserve the records and workspace and do not start a duplicate. See [main pending-result branch](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/job_handlers.py#L2065-L2089), [main pending response](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/job_read_state.py#L124-L154), and [release missing-handle response](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/job_handlers.py#L2064-L2084). The pending receipt must be available to the main read path; this does not guarantee one exists or that every missing handle is pending. For a wider execution-session candidate list, `ouroboros resume --all --list` removes the normal snapshot path's 20-row cap. It still lists only sessions reconstructed as `running` or `paused`; reconstruction failures are omitted. An older EventStore fallback replays session events without applying that cap, so `--all` may not add rows there. Neither form proves that a worker process is still alive, reveals all historical sessions, or resumes work. Check the installed help and keep using the original IDs to inspect known work. These details were checked in both the cited main source and release `v0.59.9`: [main resume implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/resume.py) · [release `v0.59.9`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/resume.py). Before resuming, cancelling, or starting a new run, establish the original owner and terminal state, Seed **file path**, target workspace and branch, uncommitted files, and effects already sent to external systems. Do not start a duplicate because a receipt was lost. In the cited revision, a particular `run workflow --resume` failure caused by an unavailable process-local check package can record the original session as failed and start a new attempt. Inspect the installed behavior and target before choosing a recovery action. Cancellation does not undo completed external effects. See [run recovery](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/run.py). **Check separately chained jobs before treating a stop as complete.** In the fixed main and release sources, cancelling the original job or execution does not automatically establish that a separately chained job was cancelled, especially after the original is terminal. Follow these steps: 1. Inspect the original result for `chained_evaluate_job_id`. If present, check that evaluation job's status and result using the same server. 2. Inspect the evaluation result for `chained_ralph_job_id`. If present, check that Ralph job's status and result using the same server. These fields appear only when the corresponding chaining path succeeds; do not assume every run has them. 3. If the user explicitly requests that a still-running follow-up stop, identify its exact ID and owner and request cancellation for that job separately using the installed server's `ouroboros_cancel_job` schema. 4. Check its later status and result and verify external effects. A cancellation request is not proof of termination or reversal. Preserve existing files and do not guess at missing IDs or start replacement work while the state is uncertain. See [main evaluation receipt](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/run_evaluate_chain.py#L150-L175), [main Ralph receipt](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/evaluate_ralph_chain.py#L462-L472), [main job cancellation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/job_handlers.py#L2148-L2189), and the corresponding release [evaluation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/run_evaluate_chain.py#L150-L175) and [Ralph](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/evaluate_ralph_chain.py#L462-L472) paths. Other versions and host integrations may differ. If the owner, state, target, or external effects remain unknown, preserve the records and ask the person responsible before guessing or starting another attempt. ## Update and partial failure `ouroboros update --check` queries remote release information; it is not an offline check. Before updating, identify the package manager and executable, affected hosts and running work. An update or refresh may change installed files and settings. If output says `Ouroboros partially updated`, the package may already have changed even though a later refresh failed. Check `ouroboros --version` in the same environment, preserve the error, and identify the failed step. Review the suggested recovery command and its target before running it. In the cited revision, rerunning `ouroboros update` when the package is already current does not automatically retry failed runtime refreshes. Do not delete or overwrite existing configuration merely to silence an error. See the [update implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/update.py). ## Verify and report After a targeted, authorized change, repeat the original check in the same machine, host and installation. For a task result, compare the Seed's goal and acceptance criteria with the actual changed files, test and evaluation output, and unresolved failures. A job ID, health `ok`, terminal job state, successful query, or evaluation request alone does not prove the requested result was achieved. Report the redacted symptom, identified installation and version, relevant ID types, commands actually run and their results, changes, and remaining uncertainty. State explicitly if real host connection, authentication, model use, external effects, or recovery were not tested. Do not claim that an action succeeded solely because it was suggested.
content/en/ai-troubleshooting.md.current: # Troubleshoot Ouroboros with an AI assistant Use this guide when installation, an MCP connection, an execution, or an update does not behave as expected. Identify the affected environment, inspect the symptom, preserve existing work, choose a targeted action, and verify the outcome. A host plugin can work without a standalone `ouroboros` command in your shell. **Version boundary:** This guide describes source revision [`592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/tree/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0), checked on 2026-11-07. A published package, a host plugin, and the MCP server launched by that host can be different versions. Check the help and behavior of the installation involved before applying these instructions. Source review and package inclusion do not establish that every host, authentication method, model, or recovery path has been tested. ## Start here Tell the assistant which machine and operating system, host application, project directory, command or request, symptom, and last error are involved. Preserve the actual job, session, execution, and auto-session IDs, if any. Ask the assistant to distinguish observations from inferences, and commands it actually ran from commands it recommends. If the affected environment has a standalone CLI, run these in its shell: ```bash command -v ouroboros ouroboros --version ouroboros --help ``` In PowerShell, use `Get-Command ouroboros` to locate the command. The result identifies that shell's CLI, not necessarily the MCP server launched by a host. If the command is missing, check the host's own plugin and MCP status; do not install another CLI solely to infer the host server's version. A different machine, user, home directory, virtual environment, or host session can select a different installation. For a source checkout, `git rev-parse HEAD` identifies that checkout, not a separately installed package. **Review output before sharing it.** Paths, project names, prompts, IDs, configuration errors, and launcher arguments can contain private information or secrets. Redact them as appropriate. Do not send credentials, tokens, a complete environment dump, or an entire configuration file. In particular, `doctor install` can display configured launcher arguments. ## Choose the symptom | Symptom | First step | If that does not resolve it | | --- | --- | --- | | The shell cannot find `ouroboros`, or the host does not recognize `ooo` | Separate the standalone CLI from the host plugin; check the affected session and installed version. | Inspect the host's plugin status and installation instructions for that version. Do not assume one installation proves the other. | | MCP tools are unavailable or connection fails | Check whether the host reports its server enabled and connected; preserve the redacted error. | Follow [MCP connection](#mcp-connection-or-authentication-fails). | | Authentication fails or health reports a credential warning | Identify the selected backend and the environment that actually launches it. Check its supported login or credential setup without sharing the credential. | A credential-presence check does not prove validity; follow [MCP connection](#mcp-connection-or-authentication-fails) and verify an authorized connection separately. | | A job appears stuck or a client disconnected | Preserve the original IDs, workspace and owner; query the existing work. | Follow [Status and recovery](#recovery) before retrying. | | Codex uses broader file or network access than expected | Check the existing job, actual worker command, and product/Codex versions. | Follow [Permission and isolation scope](#permission-scope). | | An update reports partial failure | Identify which package and refresh step changed. | Follow [Update and partial failure](#update-and-partial-failure). | | A job completed but the result seems wrong | Compare the Seed and actual files, tests and evaluation evidence. | Follow [Verify and report](#verify-and-report). | ## Diagnose without assuming a pass proves success Run the following in the affected CLI environment only if that installation provides them. Consult the relevant `--help` first and inspect the individual errors and warnings, not just the exit code. These checks are diagnostic, not repair commands; nevertheless, logging, initialization, and dependency imports can create local traces or make network requests. They are not a promise of offline or OS-isolated operation. | Command | What it inspects | What a pass does not establish | | --- | --- | --- | | `ouroboros doctor install` | Package, plugin and MCP installation surfaces and launcher information. | A live host connection or successful task. | | `ouroboros status health` | Configuration, database path, runtime availability and credential presence. | Valid authentication, a model call, or successful execution. | | `ouroboros mcp doctor` | MCP prerequisites; the default does not start a server. | The actual host connection or a model call. | | `ouroboros mcp doctor-runtime` | Bounded executable provenance, ephemeral loopback bindability and Ouroboros server registry metadata. | A live connection between the host and server. | | `ouroboros codex doctor` | Codex `ooo auto` dispatch artifacts and MCP configuration. | A live host connection or model call. | `doctor install`, `mcp doctor`, and `mcp doctor-runtime` support `--json` in the source revision above. For `mcp doctor`, `--machine-snapshot --json` returns an object containing `checks` and `machine_snapshot` rather than the default list. Redact either form before sharing. A configuration error in `status health` remains important even if other rows report `ok`. See the [installation doctor](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/doctor.py), [MCP doctor](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/mcp_doctor.py), and [health implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py). ## MCP connection or authentication fails 1. In the original host session, check whether the plugin and Ouroboros server are enabled and whether the error concerns server startup, connection, tool discovery, or authentication. Inspect the server's command or URL and environment without exposing secrets. A CLI health pass does not prove that this host uses that CLI or server. For Codex CLI, `codex mcp list` shows configured servers; in the Codex CLI TUI, `/mcp` shows MCP servers active in that session. A listed or active server does not by itself prove that a particular tool call succeeds. Do not infer that a plugin-bundled server is missing only because it is absent from `codex mcp list`; check the plugin and current session in the relevant host. See [OpenAI's Codex MCP setup guidance](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp?surface=cli#configure-with-the-cli). Codex plugin skill discovery and its bundled MCP server are separate: seeing `ouroboros-help` does not establish that the server or its tools are available, and an MCP server listing does not establish that the help skill was discovered. The plugin descriptor lists skills and MCP configuration separately ([manifest](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/.codex-plugin/plugin.json), [bundled server configuration](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/.mcp.codex.json)); verify the relevant capability in the current host session. In the cited main and release welcome flows, `CODEX_SETUP_REQUIRED` is a readiness result, not a live check of the plugin's bundled MCP server: the gate also requires Codex runtime and LLM backends, a runnable Codex CLI, and an `mcp_servers.ouroboros` entry in `$CODEX_HOME/config.toml`. Because the marketplace plugin declares its MCP server separately, an active plugin server can coexist with this result. Do not repeat `ouroboros setup --runtime codex` solely because of this message; first inspect the current host session and the target configuration. Codex setup can write persistent MCP registration and runtime/model settings. See [main welcome readiness gate](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/skills/welcome/SKILL.md#L545-L592), [release welcome readiness gate](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/skills/welcome/SKILL.md#L545-L592), and [Codex setup implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/setup.py#L2752-L2900). 2. If the relevant standalone CLI is available, read the failing rows of `ouroboros mcp doctor`. For Codex, `ouroboros codex doctor` checks the `ooo auto` dispatch setup. A failure gives a starting point; inspect the suggested changes and target before applying them. A pass still does not prove the host connection. **What Codex doctor checks:** In fixed main `592c667f` and release `0.59.9`, `ouroboros codex doctor` uses explicit `--codex-dir` first, otherwise `$CODEX_HOME`, otherwise `~/.codex`. It requires `rules/ouroboros.md`, `skills/ouroboros-auto/SKILL.md`, and an `mcp_servers.ouroboros` entry in that root's `config.toml`. It does not substitute discovery of a marketplace plugin's separate cache and bundled descriptor for those managed assets. A `BROKEN` result due to missing managed assets does not establish that an active plugin is broken. Do not automatically run the printed `codex refresh` suggestion; first identify the installation path and tools in the current host session, and review existing settings and the intended changes before installing or refreshing separate managed assets. [main checks](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/codex.py#L186-L285) · [release checks](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/codex.py#L186-L285) 3. If an additional process is appropriate, `ouroboros mcp doctor --probe-local-stdio` starts a temporary local child and checks startup and tool discovery without invoking a tool. It does not test the host's configured launcher, authentication, or model. Its Python-level restrictions are not OS confinement; interpreter startup can precede them. Ordinary doctor checks may also attempt network access. 4. `ouroboros codex doctor --live-mcp` instead launches the **configured stdio server** and checks discovery. Inspect that launcher and its potential network and other effects first. This option does not verify a URL transport or a model call. See the [Codex doctor implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/codex.py). 5. If setup reports `No runtimes found.`, inspect the runtime executable, configuration and help in the setup process's environment. Detection can involve more than the current shell's PATH. Setup and refresh can change configuration and artifacts; a failed setup does not prove that no local state was created. Preserve existing files and inspect the failed step before retrying. See [setup](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/setup.py). 6. In the Python `MCPClientAdapter` path, an SDK exception whose text contains `not found` can be misclassified as a missing tool. One comparison using the candidate offline dev server and an independent MCP SDK call checked a registered `ouroboros_job_result` with a synthetic nonexistent job ID: `Job handle not found` surfaced from the adapter as `Tool not found: ouroboros_job_result`. This is one observed Python-adapter path, not a rule for every host or SDK. Before classifying this message, confirm the same host is connected to the intended server, inspect that server's actual registered tool list, and compare the exact job ID with the original start response. See [main Interview start response](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2661-L2713), [main status query scope](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/query_handlers.py#L291-L323), [main session reconstruction requirement](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/orchestrator/session.py#L1298-L1342), and [CLI run status option](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/status.py#L374-L389). For standalone CLI status checks, replace each placeholder below with the **matching ID of the indicated type**, and check the installed help first: An original run may have separately chained evaluation or Ralph jobs. If its result includes `chained_evaluate_job_id`, query that exact job on the same server and read its terminal result; if that result includes `chained_ralph_job_id`, do the same for Ralph. These IDs appear only when the corresponding enqueue succeeds. Stopping the original job does not prove a chained job stopped. Do not invent missing IDs or cancel a follow-up automatically. If a result or owner is uncertain, preserve the records and workspace; see [the detailed chained-job checks](#chained-job-checks). Choose only the row matching the ID or list you need; do not run every command. For a job, query its status first and read its result when it is terminal. | What you have | Standalone CLI command | Next step | | --- | --- | --- | | Job ID | `ouroboros job status JOB_ID` | When terminal, use `ouroboros job result JOB_ID` for that same job. | | Execution ID | `ouroboros status execution EXECUTION_ID --events` | Inspect the returned events and linked IDs. | | Orchestrator session ID | `ouroboros status run --session-id ORCHESTRATOR_SESSION_ID` | Inspect the returned session status. | | Auto session ID | `ouroboros status auto AUTO_SESSION_ID` | Inspect auto-session status and linked work. | | Execution-session ID is missing | `ouroboros resume --list` | For a wider candidate list, use `ouroboros resume --all --list`; neither command resumes work. | ### Resume an interview To continue an Interview, use the same `session_id` with `ouroboros_interview` in the original host/MCP and send the user's actual answer as `answer`. This is a continuation, not a status-only query; it can generate another question and incur model calls and cost. For a standalone CLI interview, use the **same state directory as before** with `ouroboros init list` to find its ID, then `ouroboros init start --resume INTERVIEW_ID` to continue it. If you used `--state-dir`, pass that same path to both commands. `ouroboros resume --list` lists execution sessions, not interviews. If the host returned `delegated_to_subagent`, use the actual ID shown in the original host's Task pane; the delegation receipt is not the interview ID. See [main Interview continuation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2280-L2305), [main CLI interview resume option](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L1028-L1034), and [CLI list/state directory](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L1212-L1246). Release `v0.59.9` does not expose that field in its Interview schema or handle it as calibration: if an unsupported argument nevertheless reaches the handler without `initial_context`, it selects an answer when `answer` is present and otherwise a resume, which requires `session_id`; a host or schema may reject the argument earlier. Do not send `calibration_input` or `interview_calibration` to that release or assume it was processed; an answer or resume can change interview state and invoke a model. Check the actual connected server's tool schema and version, preserve the pending question, and use only the input that server supports; ask for an explanation in the existing host conversation instead. See [main action selection](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2100-L2128), [main calibration parameters](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/interview_calibration.py#L22-L42), and [release action selection](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/authoring_handlers.py#L2093-L2123). Other installed versions or host schemas require separate checking. `ouroboros init start --resume INTERVIEW_ID` is not a read-only status command. It continues the interview, can call the selected model for questions or scoring (and incur cost), and can update saved interview state. Depending on the path, `Proceed to generate Seed specification?` defaults to `yes`; generating a Seed writes an artifact. After Seed generation, `Start workflow now?` also defaults to `yes`, so accepting the default (pressing Enter) can start actual workflow execution. To inspect the Seed before execution, enter `n` at `Start workflow now?`; if you do not want a Seed generated, enter `n` at the Seed prompt. See [main interview, Seed, and workflow flow](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L560-L654), [main Seed persistence and workflow handoff](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L748-L812), [release flow](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L559-L653), and [release Seed persistence and workflow handoff](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/init.py#L748-L812). ### Inspect jobs and execution sessions `job result` reads the terminal output for the same job ID, including a `failed`, `cancelled`, or `interrupted` job; it is not limited to successful work. Read its status/error fields and returned failure text or payload as evidence about the outcome. A successful query only means the record was read; it does not mean the work passed its criteria. In the cited main source, `worker_blocked` is a closed failure category derived from a worker judgement class. It does not identify the underlying reason by itself. Inspect the actual result, any linked session or execution ID, and the worker's relevant output before attributing the cause. If available through the owning host, inspect only the relevant stdout/stderr and permission, backend/runtime, and environment error details; redact tokens, keys, credentials, and unrelated environment values before sharing. The source does not guarantee that raw stdout/stderr is persisted in the job result. Preserve the existing workspace, branch, uncommitted files, and external effects; do not rerun, resume, cancel, or start a duplicate while the owner or current state is uncertain. `resume --list` lists execution-session candidates; it is not an Interview list and does not resume them. Before resuming, cancelling, or starting a new run, establish the original owner and terminal state, Seed **file path**, target workspace and branch, uncommitted files, and effects already sent to external systems. Do not start a duplicate because a receipt was lost. In the cited revision, a particular `run workflow --resume` failure caused by an unavailable process-local check package can record the original session as failed and start a new attempt. Inspect the installed behavior and target before choosing a recovery action. Cancellation does not undo completed external effects. Inspect the evaluation result for `chained_ralph_job_id`. If present, check that Ralph job's status and result using the same server. These fields appear only when the corresponding chaining path succeeds; do not assume every run has them. 3. If the user explicitly requests that a still-running follow-up stop, identify its exact ID and owner and request cancellation for that job separately using the installed server's `ouroboros_cancel_job` schema. 4. Check its later status and result and verify external effects. A cancellation request is not proof of termination or reversal. Preserve existing files and do not guess at missing IDs or start replacement work while the state is uncertain. See [main evaluation receipt](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/run_evaluate_chain.py#L150-L175), [main Ralph receipt](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/evaluate_ralph_chain.py#L462-L472), [main job cancellation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/job_handlers.py#L2148-L2189), and the corresponding release [evaluation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/run_evaluate_chain.py#L150-L175) and [Ralph](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/mcp/tools/evaluate_ralph_chain.py#L462-L472) paths. Other versions and host integrations may differ. If the owner, state, target, or external effects remain unknown, preserve the records and ask the person responsible before guessing or starting another attempt. ## Update and partial failure **Identify the update target first.** A plugin-only installation can legitimately have no standalone `ouroboros` command; the `ooo update` skill assumes that CLI is available. A missing command or failed help is not sufficient evidence of a legacy installation. Do not automatically install a global CLI as a repair. Identify the CLI package, host plugin and actual MCP server separately, including the fixed Codex descriptor’s `==0.59.9` dependency pin. When the package is current, the updater returns before runtime refresh, so repeating it with `--runtime all` does not force plugin/server repair. Before updating, identify the package manager and executable, affected hosts and running work. An update or refresh may change installed files and settings. If output says `Ouroboros partially updated`, the package may already have changed even though a later refresh failed. Check `ouroboros --version` in the same environment, preserve the error, and identify the failed step. Review the suggested recovery command and its target before running it. In the cited revision, rerunning `ouroboros update` when the package is already current does not automatically retry failed runtime refreshes. Do not delete or overwrite existing configuration merely to silence an error. See the [update implementation](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/update.py). ## Verify and report After a targeted, authorized change, repeat the original check in the same machine, host and installation. For a task result, compare the Seed's goal and acceptance criteria with the actual changed files, test and evaluation output, and unresolved failures. A job ID, health `ok`, terminal job state, successful query, or evaluation request alone does not prove the requested result was achieved. Report the redacted symptom, identified installation and version, relevant ID types, commands actually run and their results, changes, and remaining uncertainty. State explicitly if real host connection, authentication, model use, external effects, or recovery were not tested. Do not claim that an action succeeded solely because it was suggested.

    이 문서의 상세 동작과 합성 관찰은 별도 언급이 없는 한 고정 소스 [`722172ef`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/tree/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2) 기준입니다. 제품 main [`592c667f`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/tree/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0), 공개 패키지 `0.59.9`, 사용 중인 플러그인과 MCP 서버는 각각 다른 판본일 수 있습니다. 여기에 기록된 시험은 해당 조건의 관찰이며 실제 사용자 환경·모델·호스트 전체를 검증하지 않았습니다. 실행 전 설치된 버전의 도움말과 [현재 제품 CLI 참조](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/docs/cli-reference.md), [현재 소스](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/tree/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros)를 대조하세요. 판본 차이를 확인하지 않은 기능은 동일하다고 가정하지 않습니다.


기준: 2026-11-04, 고정 소스 [`722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2`](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/tree/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2). 아래는 이 커밋의 독립 CLI [update 구현](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/update.py)을 설명한다. 배포 패키지 `0.59.9`를 비롯한 설치본이 이 소스와 같다고 가정하지 말고, **해당 설치 환경의** `ouroboros --version`, `ouroboros update --help`, 설치 관리자와 호스트 설정을 먼저 확인한다. 호스트에 설치한 플러그인의 갱신과 독립 CLI 패키지의 갱신은 서로 다른 경로일 수 있다. [설치 경로](/docs/first-run-detail/#install-check), [런타임별 차이](/docs/runtime-support-detail/).

## 무엇을 확인하고 변경하는가

| 명령/옵션 | 이 소스의 동작과 범위 |
| --- | --- |
| `ouroboros update --check` | PyPI에서 비-yanked 배포 파일이 하나 이상인 최신 버전 후보를 조회해 현재 버전과 비교한다. 현재 Python·플랫폼에서 그 후보가 설치 가능하다는 보장은 아니다. 패키지나 런타임을 갱신하지 않는다. 런타임 선택에 따라 Codex 플러그인 버전도 조회할 수 있다. **오프라인 검사가 아니며** PyPI 실패 시 종료 1이다. 플러그인 상태를 알 수 없다는 경고는 일치의 증거가 아니다. |
| `ouroboros update --dry-run` | 최신 버전 확인과 설치 정체성 검사를 수행하고 실행할 명령을 미리 보여준다. PyPI 조회가 필요하고, 상황에 따라 OMP 설정을 읽는 명령을 호출할 수 있다. 패키지 업그레이드와 설정 쓰기를 실행한 증거가 아니다. 최신 버전이 이미 설치돼 있으면 업그레이드 경로의 모든 단계를 미리 보여준다는 보장도 없다. |
| `ouroboros update` | 최신 버전이 있으면 기본값 **Yes**인 확인 후 패키지를 갱신하고 선택된 런타임 통합을 새로 고친다. `-y`/`--yes`는 확인을 생략하며, `--check`·`--dry-run`과 다르다. 이미 최신이어도 `--check`가 아니면 OMP가 설치된 경우 MCP tool timeout 설정을 확인하고 필요 시 변경을 시도한다. |
| `--prerelease` / `--no-prerelease` | 비교 대상에 사전 출시 버전을 포함하거나 제외한다. 생략하면 현재 설치가 사전 출시인지에 따라 선택한다. 비-yanked 배포 파일이 하나 이상 있는 릴리스를 후보로 찾는다. 이 단계는 현재 Python 버전·플랫폼·배포 파일의 호환성을 확인하지 않으므로 후보가 이 환경에 설치 가능하다고 보장하지 않는다. |
| `--runtime auto` | 기본값. 저장된 백엔드를 기준으로 갱신할 런타임을 정한다. 구성 오류가 있으면 사용 가능한 업데이트가 있을 때 변경 전에 중단할 수 있다. |
| `--runtime none` | 새 패키지 버전으로의 **업그레이드 후 런타임 refresh**를 건너뛴다. 전체 명령이 아무 설정도 건드리지 않는다는 의미는 아니다. |
| `--runtime all` | Claude와 Codex 플러그인 및 설치된 런타임 산출물의 refresh를 시도한다. 각 호스트 설정과 기존 참조, 실제 실행 파일을 먼저 확인한다. 다른 선택지는 설치본 도움말을 확인한다. |

이 구현은 실행 중인 설치의 **uv 또는 pipx receipt**로 관리자·환경·extras 등 원래 설치 프로필을 식별하고 해당 설치를 다시 사용한다. 정체성을 안전하게 확인하지 못하거나 uv의 기록된 버전 제약이 목표 버전과 충돌하면 변경 전 실패하도록 되어 있다. 임의의 전역 `pip`나 다른 가상환경이 현재 실행 파일을 갱신할 것이라고 가정하지 않는다. receipt를 직접 고치는 대신 원래 설치 관리자·프로필을 확인한다. 패키지 설치·갱신은 네트워크와 디스크 변경을 수반한다.

## 갱신 전과 후

1. 현재 실행 파일과 버전, 관리자·환경 및 필요한 extras를 기록한다. 진행 중인 작업의 ID·종료 상태와 작업 트리 변경, 호스트 플러그인 버전을 확인한다. 로컬 변경이나 DB가 원격에 보관됐다고 가정하지 않는다.
2. `--check`로 버전 정보를 확인하고 릴리스의 변경 사항과 이 환경의 호환성을 검토한다. `--dry-run`은 네트워크 없는 시험이 아니며, 설치 identity를 확인할 수 없다면 실패할 수 있다. 설치 유형·호스트 설정에 따라 표시되는 경로와 실행 계획을 확인한다.
3. 실제 갱신을 결정하면 사용할 runtime 범위와 확인 프롬프트를 검토한다. 패키지 업그레이드는 외부 패키지 획득과 로컬 환경 변경을, refresh는 호스트 설정·플러그인 관련 변경을 수반할 수 있다. 로그에 토큰이나 개인 데이터를 남기지 않는다.
4. 완료 출력과 **실행 중인 동일 환경**의 버전, 해당 호스트가 실제 노출하는 도구·설정을 확인한다. 필요하면 해당 호스트 세션을 재시작한다. 버전 번호나 프로세스 종료 0만으로 모든 런타임 통합과 실제 모델 호출 성공을 판단하지 않는다.

## 부분 갱신과 복구

업그레이드 명령 성공 후에도 새 설치 버전을 확인하지 못하거나 목표보다 낮으면 런타임 refresh를 진행하지 않고 실패한다. 패키지는 이미 바뀌었을 수 있으므로 출력과 같은 환경의 버전부터 확인한다. 패키지 갱신 뒤 일부 플러그인·설정 refresh가 실패하면 `Ouroboros partially updated`와 실패 단계·복구 명령을 출력하고 종료 1을 반환한다. 그 명령의 실제 대상과 부작용을 확인한 뒤 필요한 단계만 다시 수행한다. **패키지가 이미 최신일 때 `ouroboros update`를 다시 실행해도 실패한 런타임 refresh를 다시 시도하지 않는다.** 무조건 반복 실행하지 말고 출력된 복구 안내와 설치 버전의 `setup --help`를 확인한다.

Claude CLI가 없는 경우에는 코드가 해당 refresh를 건너뛰고 추후 setup 안내를 표시할 수 있다. Codex 플러그인의 pinned marketplace ref나 버전 불일치 경고도 실제 참조를 확인하기 전에는 해결됐다고 판단하지 않는다. `--runtime none`으로 의도적으로 생략한 통합도 따로 설정 여부를 확인한다. 특정 호스트 세션 재시작은 해당 프로세스의 연결·상태에 영향을 줄 수 있으므로 진행 중인 작업부터 확인한다.

**검증 범위:** 고정 커밋과 해당 update 소스·대상 테스트 차이가 없는 로컬 checkout에서 PyPI·설치 관리자 등 외부 호출을 대역 처리한 `TestCheckFlow`와 Codex check 테스트 **6개가 통과**했다. 실제 PyPI 조회, 패키지 업그레이드, 런타임 refresh, 사용자 설정 변경과 모든 설치 관리자 조합은 시험하지 않았다. 위 부작용·분기는 소스와 테스트 기반 설명이며 다른 배포판의 동작 보장이 아니다. [원본 update 테스트](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/722172ef096767583679d04aef5e847458fee6b2/tests/unit/cli/test_update.py).

## 플러그인과 CLI의 갱신 대상을 먼저 구분하기 {#plugin-only-update}

아래는 제품 main `592c667f`와 release `0.59.9`의 소스·스킬을 대조한 범위입니다. **호스트에 plugin만 설치했다면 터미널에 `ouroboros`가 없어도 정상일 수 있습니다.** 명령이 없거나 도움말을 실행할 수 없다는 이유만으로 구형 설치·손상이라고 단정하지 마세요. `ooo update` 스킬은 별도 CLI의 `ouroboros update` 호출을 전제로 하므로 plugin-only 설치에서 그대로 동작한다고 보장할 수 없습니다.

| 실제 설치 형태 | 먼저 확인할 대상 | 갱신 후 확인할 것 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 호스트 plugin만 사용 | 같은 호스트의 실제 plugin 출처·참조와 MCP launcher의 command/args. 별도 CLI 존재를 가정하지 않습니다. | 해당 호스트가 지원하는 plugin 갱신의 범위·기존 pin을 확인합니다. 전역 CLI 신규 설치나 pin 해제를 자동 복구로 대신하지 않습니다. |
| 독립 CLI | 실제 실행 파일과 그 환경의 설치 관리자·extras·원래 설치 기록. `--check`는 원격 정보를 조회합니다. | 같은 환경의 패키지 버전과 실패 단계. 다른 CLI 환경의 성공을 해당 설치의 갱신으로 세지 않습니다. |
| CLI와 호스트 plugin 모두 사용 | CLI 패키지, 설치된 plugin metadata, 그 plugin이 띄우는 MCP 서버를 별도 식별합니다. | 패키지 갱신, 호스트 통합 refresh, 실제 연결된 서버의 도구·판본을 각각 확인합니다. 하나의 버전 일치나 종료 0이 나머지 성공을 보장하지 않습니다. |

고정 Codex descriptor `.mcp.codex.json`은 서버 의존성을 `ouroboros-ai[mcp]==0.59.9`로 지정합니다. plugin을 refresh해도 **선택된 descriptor에 그 pin이 남아 있으면** 별도 CLI 업그레이드가 그 서버 의존성을 바꾸지 않습니다. 반면 조사한 Claude `.mcp.json`의 의존성은 무버전 `ouroboros-ai[mcp]`이므로 두 host의 판본 선택을 같은 방식으로 가정하지 않습니다. 설치된 plugin version 표시는 실제 서버 프로세스 버전·schema 검증을 대신하지 않습니다.

이 두 제품 판본의 updater는 패키지가 최신이면 runtime refresh 분기 전에 반환하므로 `--runtime all`을 붙여 재실행해도 plugin 갱신을 강제하지 않습니다. 업그레이드가 진행되는 경우에도 `--runtime codex`의 setup/rules·skills refresh와 `--runtime all` 분기의 별도 Codex marketplace refresh는 구분해야 합니다. plugin 하나의 문제를 해결하려고 관련 없는 host까지 `all`로 갱신하거나 기존 marketplace 참조를 임의로 해제하지 마세요. 부분 실패의 실제 단계와 범위부터 확인합니다.

근거: [main update 스킬](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/skills/update/SKILL.md), [release update 스킬](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/skills/update/SKILL.md), [main updater](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/update.py#L1052-L1070), [release updater](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/5f5fca90662861201ff0a26f502edd22b272c4c6/src/ouroboros/cli/commands/update.py#L1051-L1069), [Codex descriptor](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/.mcp.codex.json), [Claude descriptor](https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/blob/592c667f076c3dad7ef68d7844e91480d80135d0/.mcp.json). 이는 정적 대조이며 실제 host 갱신·서버 재연결·모델 실행은 시험하지 않았습니다.
